suppliers.label: NVIDIA
suppliers.disclosed_mix: FY2026 10-K: two unnamed direct customers were 22% and 14% of total revenue; NVIDIA does not itemize AI-lab vs neocloud vs hyperscaler mix.

suppliers.label: AMD
suppliers.disclosed_mix: No single customer reached 10% of revenue in FY2025 per 10-K; AMD doesn't break out AI-lab vs hyperscaler mix for Instinct GPUs.

suppliers.label: TSMC
suppliers.disclosed_mix: Analyst estimates from TSMC disclosures: Nvidia ~22% and Apple ~18% of FY2026 revenue; Nvidia overtook Apple as TSMC's top customer (Jan 2026).

customers.name: AMD
customers.deal: N3/N4 wafers for Instinct MI series

customers.name: Broadcom
customers.deal: N3 wafers for custom AI ASICs/TPU

suppliers.label: Broadcom
suppliers.disclosed_mix: Mgmt points to ~6 named hyperscaler/AI-lab XPU customers underpinning a projected >$100B AI semiconductor revenue run-rate by FY2027.

suppliers.label: Marvell
suppliers.disclosed_mix: Mgmt: AWS Trainium and Microsoft Maia anchor Marvell's AI ASIC business, ~20-25% custom-ASIC design share per Bloomberg Intelligence estimate.

suppliers.label: MediaTek
suppliers.disclosed_mix: Mgmt guided AI ASIC revenue toward high end of ~US$16B target next year, ~20% of total AI ASIC market (Q3 2026 earnings call).

suppliers.label: Micron
suppliers.disclosed_mix: Micron held ~18-21% of HBM market share in 2026 per TrendForce; management cites ~20% of its HBM allocation going to Nvidia's Vera Rubin ramp.

suppliers.label: SK Hynix
suppliers.disclosed_mix: SK hynix: Nvidia was 13.35% of H1 2026 revenue (down from 24% in FY2025); company disclosed a second customer topped 10% of revenue.

suppliers.label: Samsung
suppliers.disclosed_mix: Samsung's HBM revenue share of its DRAM mix rose from 21% to 33% in Q2 2026 per TrendForce; Nvidia was absent from Samsung's top-5 customers as of mid-2026.

suppliers.label: Microsoft
suppliers.disclosed_mix: Microsoft disclosed $24.1B FY2026 revenue tied to OpenAI arrangements (~7% of total revenue); CFO Amy Hood: ex-OpenAI growth was 25%.

customers.name: Meta
customers.deal: Buys Llama model access via Foundry

suppliers.label: Amazon
suppliers.disclosed_mix: AWS backlog doubled to ~$496B by Jun 2026 from $244B; mgmt says Anthropic and OpenAI each added $100B+ in commitments in 2026 (earnings calls).

suppliers.label: Oracle
suppliers.disclosed_mix: Oracle's $664B RPO (Aug 2026) includes ~$300B tied to OpenAI/Stargate (~45%) per reporting; Oracle discloses aggregate RPO, not named-customer %.

suppliers.label: Alphabet
suppliers.disclosed_mix: Google Cloud backlog was $560.8B as of Sep 2026 (of $567.7B total); $16.8B tied to Crux AI JV per 10-Q; no AI-lab % breakout disclosed.
